note: Macau's largest retail banks are Bank of China (Macau), Banco Nacional Ultramarino, ICBC (Macau), Tai Fung and HSBC. Bank of China Macau's site and Banco Nacional Ultramarino's www host didn't answer this research (no connection, 2026-10-30), BNU's other host shows a captcha element, which this research doesn't pass, ICBC Macau's answers 403, and Bank of China (Hong Kong)'s Macau card pages (the cards Tai Fung also serves) carry no fee table; so only HSBC's Macau branch is written. HSBC Macau's key facts statement for its credit cards (read again 2026-10-30): purchases and cash advances carry an effective annual rate of 29.25%, accrued daily; interest-free up to 56 days; the minimum payment the fees and charges billed plus 5% of the statement balance, at least 50 patacas, plus any overdue or over-limit amount (written as 5% with a 50 floor; the billed fees aren't added); the primary card's annual fee: 滙財卡 and 萬事達卡 220 patacas (or Hong Kong dollars), 滙財金卡 and 萬事達金卡 480, the UnionPay dual-currency Diamond card 1,000 patacas; a cash advance a 2% cash advance fee and a 3% handling fee, written as 5%, at least 30 patacas at an ATM (70 at the counter, not written); spending in another currency 1.95% (1% on the UnionPay dual-currency card, outside patacas, Hong Kong dollars and renminbi); a late payment 5% of the minimum payment, at least 120 and at most 200 patacas; over the limit 130 patacas a cycle. The Hong Kong dollar and renminbi versions' sums are the same figures in those currencies and aren't written separately. No returned-payment fee is stated.

sources.title: 香港上海滙豐銀行有限公司（澳門分行），信用卡資料概要
sources.said: 當閣下開立閣下的信用卡戶口時為 29.25%，而本行會不時作出檢討。 ... 財務費用按日累算並按每年利率 29.25%計算（即上列的實際年利率）。 免息還款期 長達56日 ... 單結欠（扣除當期誌入的任何費用及收費）的5%， 或 (b) 澳門幣/港幣50元，以較高者為準 ... 滙財卡 MOP/HKD220 MOP/HKD110 滙財金卡 MOP/HKD480 MOP/HKD240 萬事達卡 MOP/HK ... 萬事達金卡 MOP/HKD480 MOP/HKD240 銀聯雙幣信用卡 銀聯雙幣鑽石卡 澳門幣 1,000 元 ... 本行會在現金貸款當日收取貸款額2%的現金貸款費及貸款額3% 的手續費 ... 澳門幣/港幣個人信用卡 – 澳門幣 / 港幣30元 ... 交易，會徵收交易金額的1.95%。 ... 就每項非澳門幣、非港幣及非人民幣進行的信用卡交易，會徵收交易金額的 1%。 ... 最低付款額的5%（最低澳門幣／港幣120元，最高澳門幣／港幣200元） ... 澳門幣／港幣 130 元
